NKJV.1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NKJV.2: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a person sins unintentionally against any of the commandments of the LORD in anything which ought not to be done, and does any of them,
NKJV.3: if the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, then let him offer to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without blemish as a sin offering.
NKJV.4: He shall bring the bull to the door of the tabernacle of meeting before the LORD, lay his hand on the bull’s head, and kill the bull before the LORD.
NKJV.5: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it to the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.6: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
NKJV.7: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of meeting; and he shall pour the remaining blood of the bull at the base of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.8: He shall take from it all the fat of the bull as the sin offering. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat which is on the entrails,
NKJV.9: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove,
NKJV.10: as it was taken from the bull of the sacrifice of the peace offering; and the priest shall burn them on the altar of the burnt offering.
NKJV.11: But the bull’s hide and all its flesh, with its head and legs, its entrails and offal—
NKJV.12: the whole bull he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
NKJV.13: ‘Now if the whole congregation of Israel sins unintentionally, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done something against any of the commandments of the LORD in anything which should not be done, and are guilty;
NKJV.14: when the sin which they have committed becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for the sin, and bring it before the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.15: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD. Then the bull shall be killed before the LORD.
NKJV.16: The anointed priest shall bring some of the bull’s blood to the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.17: Then the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil.
NKJV.18: And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of meeting; and he shall pour the remaining blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.19: He shall take all the fat from it and burn it on the altar.
NKJV.20: And he shall do with the bull as he did with the bull as a sin offering; thus he shall do with it. So the priest shall make atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
NKJV.21: Then he shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is a sin offering for the assembly.
NKJV.22: ‘When a ruler has sinned, and done something unintentionally against any of the commandments of the LORD his God in anything which should not be done, and is guilty,
NKJV.23: or if his sin which he has committed comes to his knowledge, he shall bring as his offering a kid of the goats, a male without blemish.
NKJV.24: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it at the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD. It is a sin offering.
NKJV.25: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
NKJV.26: And he shall burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of the peace offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
NKJV.27: ‘If anyone of the common people sins unintentionally by doing something against any of the commandments of the LORD in anything which ought not to be done, and is guilty,
NKJV.28: or if his sin which he has committed comes to his knowledge, then he shall bring as his offering a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has committed.
NKJV.29: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering at the place of the burnt offering.
NKJV.30: Then the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
NKJV.31: He shall remove all its fat, as fat is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offering; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a sweet aroma to the LORD. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
NKJV.32: ‘If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.
NKJV.33: Then he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it as a sin offering at the place where they kill the burnt offering.
NKJV.34: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
NKJV.35: He shall remove all its fat, as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire to the LORD. So the priest shall make atonement for his sin that he has committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

ESV.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “Speak to the people of Israel, saying, If anyone sins unintentionally  in any of the LORD's commandments about things not to be done, and does any one of them,

ESV.4: He shall bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before the LORD and lay his hand on the head of the bull and kill the bull before the LORD.
ESV.5: And the anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent of meeting,
ESV.6: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle part of the blood seven times before the LORD in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
ESV.7: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before the LORD that is in the tent of meeting, and all the rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
ESV.8: And all the fat of the bull of the sin offering he shall remove from it, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails

ESV.10: (just as these are taken from the ox of the sacrifice of the peace offerings); and the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
ESV.11: But the skin of the bull and all its flesh, with its head, its legs, its entrails, and its dung —

ESV.16: Then the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull into the tent of meeting,
ESV.17: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.
ESV.18: And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is in the tent of meeting before the LORD, and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
ESV.19: And all its fat he shall take from it and burn on the altar.
ESV.20: Thus shall he do with the bull. As he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
ESV.21: And he shall carry the bull outside the camp and burn it up as he burned the first bull; it is the sin offering for the assembly.
ESV.22: “When a leader sins, doing unintentionally any one of all the things that by the commandments of the LORD his God ought not to be done, and realizes his guilt,

ESV.24: and shall lay his hand on the head of the goat and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD; it is a sin offering.
ESV.25: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
ESV.26: And all its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. So the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and he shall be forgiven.

ESV.28: or the sin which he has committed is made known to him, he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has committed.
ESV.29: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
ESV.30: And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.
ESV.31: And all its fat he shall remove, as the fat is removed from the peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasing aroma to the LORD. And the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.
ESV.32: “If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish
ESV.33: and lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
ESV.34: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.
ESV.35: And all its fat he shall remove as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on top of the LORD's food offerings. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed, and he shall be forgiven.

NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'If a person sins unintentionally in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and commits any of them,
NASB.3: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer to the LORD a bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.
NASB.4: 'He shall bring the bull to the doorway of the tent of meeting before the LORD, and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull and slay the bull before the LORD.
NASB.5: 'Then the anointed priest is to take some of the blood of the bull and bring it to the tent of meeting,
NASB.6: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
NASB.7: 'The priest shall also put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense which is before the LORD in the tent of meeting; and all the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering which is at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
NASB.8: 'He shall remove from it all the fat of the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat which is on the entrails,
NASB.9: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys

NLT.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,

NET.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses:
NET.2: “Tell the Israelites, ‘When a person sins by straying unintentionally from any of the Lord’s commandments which must not be violated, and violates any one of them —
NET.3: “‘If the high priest sins so that the people are guilty, on account of the sin he has committed he must present a flawless young bull to the LORD for a sin offering.
NET.4: He must bring the bull to the entrance of the Meeting Tent before the LORD, lay his hand on the head of the bull, and slaughter the bull before the LORD.
NET.5: Then that high priest must take some of the blood of the bull and bring it to the Meeting Tent.
NET.6: The priest must dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD toward the front of the veil-canopy of the sanctuary.
NET.7: The priest must put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Meeting Tent, and all the rest of the bull’s blood he must pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.
NET.8: “‘Then he must take up all the fat from the sin offering bull: the fat covering the entrails and all the fat surrounding the entrails,
NET.9: the two kidneys with the fat on their sinews, and the protruding lobe on the liver (which he is to remove along with the kidneys)
NET.10: — just as it is taken from the ox of the peace offering sacrifice — and the priest must offer them up in smoke on the altar of burnt offering.
NET.11: But the hide of the bull, all its flesh along with its head and its legs, its entrails, and its dung —
NET.12: all the rest of the bull — he must bring outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place, to the fatty ash pile, and he must burn it on a wood fire; it must be burned on the fatty ash pile.
NET.13: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel strays unintentionally and the matter is not noticed by the assembly, and they violate one of the Lord’s commandments, which must not be violated, so they become guilty,
NET.14: the assembly must present a young bull for a sin offering when the sin they have committed becomes known. They must bring it before the Meeting Tent,
NET.15: the elders of the congregation must lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD, and someone must slaughter the bull before the LORD.
NET.16: Then the high priest must bring some of the blood of the bull to the Meeting Tent,
NET.17: and that priest must dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD toward the front of the veil-canopy.
NET.18: He must put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD in the Meeting Tent, and all the rest of the blood he must pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.
NET.19: “‘Then the priest must take all its fat and offer the fat up in smoke on the altar.
NET.20: He must do with the rest of the bull just as he did with the bull of the sin offering; this is what he must do with it. So the priest will make atonement on their behalf and they will be forgiven.
NET.21: He must bring the rest of the bull outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull — it is the sin offering of the assembly.
NET.22: “‘Whenever a leader, by straying unintentionally, sins and violates one of the commandments of the LORD his God which must not be violated, and he pleads guilty,
NET.23: or his sin that he committed is made known to him, he must bring a flawless male goat as his offering.
NET.24: He must lay his hand on the head of the male goat and slaughter it in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD — it is a sin offering.
NET.25: Then the priest must take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he must pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
NET.26: Then the priest must offer all of its fat up in smoke on the altar like the fat of the peace offering sacrifice. So the priest will make atonement on his behalf for his sin and he will be forgiven.
NET.27: “‘If an ordinary individual sins by straying unintentionally when he violates one of the Lord’s commandments which must not be violated, and he pleads guilty
NET.28: or his sin that he committed is made known to him, he must bring a flawless female goat as his offering for the sin that he committed.
NET.29: He must lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
NET.30: Then the priest must take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he must pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.
NET.31: Then he must remove all of its fat (just as fat was removed from the peace offering sacrifice) and the priest must offer it up in smoke on the altar for a soothing aroma to the LORD. So the priest will make atonement on his behalf and he will be forgiven.
NET.32: “‘But if he brings a sheep as his offering, for a sin offering, he must bring a flawless female.
NET.33: He must lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it for a sin offering in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
NET.34: Then the priest must take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he must pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.
NET.35: Then the one who brought the offering must remove all its fat (just as the fat of the sheep is removed from the peace offering sacrifice) and the priest must offer them up in smoke on the altar on top of the other gifts of the LORD. So the priest will make atonement on his behalf for his sin which he has committed and he will be forgiven.

NRSVCE.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NRSVCE.2: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: When anyone sins unintentionally in any of the LORD’s commandments about things not to be done, and does any one of them:
NRSVCE.3: If it is the anointed priest who sins, thus bringing guilt on the people, he shall offer for the sin that he has committed a bull of the herd without blemish as a sin offering to the LORD.
NRSVCE.4: He shall bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before the LORD and lay his hand on the head of the bull; the bull shall be slaughtered before the LORD.
NRSVCE.5: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent of meeting.
NRSVCE.6: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.
NRSVCE.7: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is in the tent of meeting before the LORD; and the rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
NRSVCE.8: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of sin offering: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is around the entrails;
NRSVCE.9: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins; and the appendage of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys,
NRSVCE.10: just as these are removed from the ox of the sacrifice of well-being. The priest shall turn them into smoke upon the altar of burnt offering.
NRSVCE.11: But the skin of the bull and all its flesh, as well as its head, its legs, its entrails, and its dung —
NRSVCE.12: all the rest of the bull — he shall carry out to a clean place outside the camp, to the ash heap, and shall burn it on a wood fire; at the ash heap it shall be burned.
NRSVCE.13: If the whole congregation of Israel errs unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly, and they do any one of the things that by the LORD’s commandments ought not to be done and incur guilt;
NRSVCE.14: when the sin that they have committed becomes known, the assembly shall offer a bull of the herd for a sin offering and bring it before the tent of meeting.
NRSVCE.15: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the LORD.
NRSVCE.16: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull into the tent of meeting,
NRSVCE.17: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, in front of the curtain.
NRSVCE.18: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the tent of meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
NRSVCE.19: He shall remove all its fat and turn it into smoke on the altar.
NRSVCE.20: He shall do with the bull just as is done with the bull of sin offering; he shall do the same with this. The priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
NRSVCE.21: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull; it is the sin offering for the assembly.

NRSVCE.24: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat; it shall be slaughtered at the spot where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD; it is a sin offering.

NRSVCE.29: You shall lay your hand on the head of the sin offering; and the sin offering shall be slaughtered at the place of the burnt offering.
NRSVCE.30: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

NRSVCE.33: You shall lay your hand on the head of the sin offering; and it shall be slaughtered as a sin offering at the spot where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

The Sin Offering

NIV.2: “Say to the Israelites: ‘When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord’s commands—
NIV.3: “‘If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the Lord a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.
NIV.4: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the Lord. He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it before the Lord.
NIV.5: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and carry it into the Tent of Meeting.
NIV.6: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord, in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.
NIV.7: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the bull’s blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
NIV.8: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,
NIV.9: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys—
NIV.10: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
NIV.11: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the inner parts and offal—
NIV.12: that is, all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it in a wood fire on the ash heap.
NIV.13: “‘If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord’s commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, they are guilty.

NIV.17: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the Lord seven times in front of the curtain.

NIV.19: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,
NIV.20: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.
NIV.21: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.
NIV.22: “‘When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the Lord his God, he is guilty.

NIV.29: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.
